title: Experimental Neuroscience Bootcamp
summary: This five-day online bootcamp provides scientists with a deep understanding of the technological foundations of their experimental work. Participants learn through hands-on exercises how sensors, computers, and AI systems function, rather than just using them as black boxes. By the end of the course, they receive a certificate and join a global network of researchers who truly understand their tools.
